30.08.2022 WPSB No. 526 of 2022 
Hon’ble Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Hon’ble Ramesh Chandra Khulbe, J. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the petitioner. 
Mr. D.S. Patni, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, 
learned counsel for respondent No. 1. 
Mr. Vikas Pande, learned Standing
Counsel for the State / respondent No. 2. 
The petitioner has preferred the present 
writ petition seeking the following amounts : 
A. Arrears of 7th Pay Commission – 
(w.e.f. 01.01.2016 to 
31.12.2016) 
Rs. 1,22,435/- 
(sanctioned but 
not paid 
B. Arrears of 7th Pay Commission – 
(w.e.f. 01.01.2017 to 
30.09.2017) 
Rs.76,747/- 
(sanctioned but 
not paid) 
C. Amount of Revised Gratuity - Rs. 5,85,904/- 
Total Rs. 7,85,086/- 
 
Mr. Patni, the learned Senior Counsel, 
who appears on advance notice, on 
instructions, states that the respondent No. 1 
disputes the claim “A”. He states that so far 
as the claim “C” is concerned, the same should 
be released on it being sanctioned. So far as 
Claim “B” is concerned, he states that the 
same would be released within next two 
months.  Let the respondent release the amount 
under Claim “B” within two months, as stated 
above. So far as claims “A” and “C” are 
concerned, the respondents may file their 
counter-affidavits within six weeks. Rejoinder 
before the next date. 
List the matter on 10.01.2023. 
 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
 30.08.2022 30.08.2022
Negi
